tool: tools/eval_occlusion.py (cells run one per process, then merged)
disclaimer: Synthetic rendered scenes only (sim/). These numbers measure the vision pipeline against a model of the board and darts; they are not evidence of real-board accuracy.
evidence_note: Produced from a snapshot of the working tree committed as "M1-05d: Ceiling mount profiles" (M1-05c calibration, M1-05b segmentation).

settings.base: reset after every dart (throw by throw); earlier darts are in the base image
settings.visibility: geometric: tip image point covered (>= 50%) by an earlier dart outline (hidden_by_earlier) or by the dart's own barrel/shaft/flight (hidden_by_self)
